description: Build the unsigned transactions that launch a coin on higher.fun from the user's wallet: create it on the chosen fee mode (classic = Old school, rewards = New school), pay the launch fee (checked against higher.fun's on-chain fee wallet and cap), an optional first buy, and for New school an optional creator lock. Needs metadata_uri: higher.fun's image and metadata upload needs a wallet sign-in Highwire can't do, so without it the tool returns the metadata JSON to host first. Reuse the same idempotency_key on retries: it keeps the same mint, so the coin (and its fee) can only happen once, on any server instance. Set confirm_launch to true only after the user approved the launch, its cost and its fee mode. Returns the transactions and a sign_url for the user's wallet.

confirm_launch.description: Set to true only after the user approved this launch.

creator_lock_pct.description: rewards only: lock this % of supply for the creator (7-day cliff after graduation, then 30 days linear).

dev_buy_sol.description: SOL for the creator's first buy, in the same transaction. At most 10.

fee_mode.description: classic: Cheapest. On the curve, no trading fee to the creator or higher.fun, only Raydium's 0.25%. rewards: Creator rewards. The creator earns 0.25% of every trade, plus pool fees after graduation.

idempotency_key.description: A unique, unguessable key for this coin (a random UUID). Reuse it on retries: it fixes the coin's mint address.

image_url.description: https URL of the coin's image, put in the prepared metadata.

max_slippage_bps.description: Slippage for the first buy, in bps.

metadata_uri.description: https URL of the coin's hosted metadata JSON.

ticker.description: Ticker, 1-10 letters or digits, without the $.

wallet.description: The creator's wallet, which signs and pays (public key only).

name: build_launch
title: Build a coin launch (unsigned)
